scope: same-frame suppression/canonicalization before geometry-only association; no cross-track merge or retirement

canonical_selection.ambiguity_policy: suppress only when exactly one already-selected canonical observation passes all duplicate gates; otherwise preserve observation and mark ambiguous

rationale.mask_threshold: accept substantial overlap or near-containment, while requiring independent 3D agreement
rationale.geometry_threshold: require near-coincident 3D bounds and center to reject depth-separated image overlap and small objects inside large masks
rationale.support_threshold: require meaningful valid depth and accepted cluster support on both masks
rationale.canonical_order: prefer the observation with strongest P3 support; deterministic tie-breaks do not use class, identity, or GT
